DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox).

The patient's history of a brother with chickenpox one month ago, combined with the daycare exposure and the presence of multiple lesions, strongly suggests active varicella infection. The description of "painless, nonpruritic papules" is consistent with the early eruptive phase of the disease. I will proceed with monitoring for the characteristic progression of lesions to different stages (papules, vesicles, crusts) to confirm the diagnosis.
